simple.summary: הָדָה (hâdâh) means to stretch forth the hand First listed occurrence: Isa 11 8.

definitions.full: H1911. hadah הָדָה verb stretch out the hand (compare Arabic lead, guide , Aramaic Pa`el ) Isa 11:8 הָדָה יָדוֺ , followed by עַל , the weaned child shall stretch out his hand upon .
